title: anacamptis pyramidalis subsp. durandii
intro: Anacamptis pyramidalis subsp. durandii, commonly known as the Pyramidal Orchid, is a subspecies of orchid that belongs to the Asclepiadaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Anacamptis pyramidalis subsp. durandii include reducing fever, soothing digestive issues, and acting as an antiseptic. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
